baseline_semantics: Classic admits before current-layer dispatch; an admitted miss can execute on GPU immediately
decision: Do not build or enable staging for these predictors; richer signals and other models remain untested
limitations: Existing profiler-perturbed GPT-OSS traces, not a live staging or throughput experiment
Copy occupancy is not proof of critical-path exposure or removable latency
Each heldout request supplies only 59 scored tokens after 64-token history warmup
Scratch simulation starts empty, uses first-free slots and ignores baseline DMA, DRAM contention, biases and device-to-device commit
One technical training request and three distinct heldout prompts; no Coder or Qwen admission profile
The traces record model filenames and plan hashes but not all model-shard or backend library hashes
No model weights, installed backends, profiles or application defaults were changed

scope: Classic pre-admission misses minus observed CPU mask infer promotions; same-dispatch CUDA API launches are cross-checked per projection
Scratch transfers, GPU-to-GPU commit, cache and CPU bandwidth contention are not modeled
Independent readiness uses the elapsed gap and observed median copies, without copy-engine or capacity sharing

Scratch scenarios start empty after warmup and use a first-free policy and one speculative copy queue with queued-job cancellation; they ignore baseline DMA, DRAM contention, biases and GPU-to-GPU commit
Isolated intervals exclude recorded CPU graphs, kernels, copies, memsets and observer ranges; unrecorded work may remain
Duration overlap and isolated activity are not causally exposed or removable latency
Single instrumented request; no full-logit, target-platform throughput or future model claim

trained_adjacent_predictor.features: past 63-token selection count, age and previous router rank of an expert last observed CPU-cold, plus its rank in the already-observed preceding-layer route
limitations: One training request and three distinct holdouts on one model; no model-generalization claim
No heldout labels influence training or selection thresholds
No live scratch capacity, copy-engine queue, GPU-to-GPU commit or CPU/PCIe contention is modeled
Independent timeliness is not evidence that concurrent transfers fit or reduce latency
Inferred decisions are corroborated against CUDA projection-copy launches per dispatcher
Trace filenames and plan hashes match; model-shard and all backend library hashes are not recorded
trained_adjacent_predictor.score: (training hits + 1) / (training observations + 20); one expert per layer at fixed thresholds
